checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images, no extra cover/closing
must.why: Square 1:1 images, a cover slide exists, only 5 images shown with the 6th missing from the grade set.

must.item: Five supplied tips verbatim, in order
must.why: Tips are different wording (Silence Your Phone, Work in 25-Minute Sprints, etc.) and in a different order.
Numbers 1-4 appear on slides 2-5 but the cover is unnumbered; no 5 visible.
Phone, stopwatch, checkmark number, desk with plant all fit their tips.
Design is sage green, not blue-and-white; text is readable but the layout is inconsistent.

exact_text.read_as: Only 'Then take a 5-minute break' as a subline

faults.what: Wrong aspect ratio: 1:1 squares instead of 4:5 portrait
Tips not the supplied wording and out of order; 'Take a short break' absent as a slide
Extra cover slide with 'Swipe' that was not requested
Inconsistent layouts across slides and numbering style; slide 5 clipped desk legs

summary: The output is a set of green square slides with invented tips, not the five supplied tips, the 4:5 portrait format or the blue-and-white design, so it fails the brief.
